description_en: Queries the information about the 4G subscriber identity module (SIM) card used by the WAN port of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 获取智能接入网关设备WAN 4G网卡信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-wan-4g --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagWan4G

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the 4G SIM card

Mac.description_en: The MAC address of the 4G SIM card

Priority.description_en: The priority of the 4G SIM card. The default value is 99, which indicates the lowest priority and cannot be modified
Priority.description_zh: 4G网卡优先级。优先级默认值为99，表示最低优先级，且优先级不支持调整

Status.description_en:
The status of the 4G SIM card. Valid value:

Normal: The 4G SIM card is available.
Abnormal: The 4G SIM card encountered an error.
Unavailable: No 4G SIM card is inserted
Status.description_zh:
4G网卡状态：

Normal：状态正常。
Abnormal：状态异常。
Unavailable：无4G网卡

Strength.description_en:
The signal strength of the 4G network. Valid values:

High: strong signals.
Middle: medium-strength signals.
Low: weak signals.
Unavailable: no signal
Strength.description_zh:
4G信号强度：

High：强。
Middle：中。
Low：弱。
Unavailable：无信号

TrafficState.description_en:
The network status of the 4G SIM card. Valid values:

active: The 4G SIM card is used to establish the active connection. Network traffic is transmitted over the 4G SIM card first.
standby: The 4G SIM card is used to establish a standby connection. Network traffic is not transmitted over the 4G SIM card unless the active connection fails
TrafficState.description_zh:
4G网卡流量状态。

active：表示该4G网卡为主用链路，当前流量经过该4G网卡进行传输。
standby：表示该4G网卡为备用链路，暂不转发流量。在主用链路故障后，流量经过该4G网卡进行传输
